task.title: Diagnostic: Troubleshoot database and storage issues
task.shortdesc: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Diagnose local SQLite, storage path, backup, and profile visibility issues without editing database rows directly.

prereq.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Use this procedure when profiles disappear, writes fail, migration evidence is unclear, backup checksums do not match, or BPM_DATABASE_URL points to an unexpected location.

context.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Current source deployment uses local storage such as sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/bpm.db and repository-owned files under data/, schema cache paths, and documentation site paths. There is no managed backup or restore orchestration in BPM 0.9.0.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 1: Confirm the active database URL and working directory.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Record BPM_DATABASE_URL, current directory, source revision, and whether the process runs from Linux filesystem or /mnt/c. Do not assume two shells point at the same data/bpm.db.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 2: Check migration and profile API evidence before opening storage files.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Focused rerun: alembic upgrade head, then curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/profiles?limit=50. If the API returns expected profiles, the symptom may be filter, lifecycle, or browser state.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 3: Verify backup evidence before destructive recovery.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Check mkdir -p backups, cp data/bpm.db backups/bpm-pre-update.db, and sha256sum backups/bpm-pre-update.db records. Keep exports of critical policies.json profiles as separate evidence.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 4: Avoid direct database row edits.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Do not edit SQLite rows, generated artifacts, or schema cache files as routine recovery. Use documented profile archive, restore, import, export, or update-from-source procedures instead.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 5: Escalate with storage evidence when recovery is unsafe.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Include database URL, file path, checksum, migration command, API response, and backup/export evidence.
info.note: If no verified pre-failure backup exists, stop before deleting or replacing data/bpm.db; BPM does not provide point-in-time recovery.

result.p: L’opérateur obtient un diagnostic classifié, préserve user data et connaît le prochain smallest rerun. The operator has a storage diagnosis that preserves user data and separates database state from UI or filter symptoms.

postreq.p: Après correction, revenez au workflow Administrator/DevOps lié et relancez seulement les checks affectés. After storage is stable, rerun health/readiness and the smallest affected API workflow.
